dossier.subject: AGV vehicle PC (one per unit)
dossier.basis: Repository documents and deploy files only (branch gvievo-sub, fbc69aa). Nothing was read from a live unit.

status_legend.deploy_intent: defined by a repo deploy file; active only once install.sh (or the named step) has run on that unit
status_legend.inferred: derived from other recorded values, not stated directly
status_legend.not_in_repo: not recorded anywhere in the repository

units.note: As-built reference. Runs the 2026-11-16 code on the older installed service files; install.sh with the current deploy files is still owed (alpha-setup.md section 11).
Identical hardware. Platform freeze not yet run as of 2026-11-18; reached setup step 15 on 2026-11-18.

cpu.configured_ceiling_note: 2200000 kHz = ratio 22, an exact P-state; about +10 % over base clock
cpu.thermal_history: At stock (3.6 GHz, PL2 25 W) unit 1 reached 100 °C and thermal-throttled 86 times in 2 h (2026-10-02). The caps were introduced for this.

services.cpu-freq-cap.service: turbo on, every policy's scaling_max_freq = 2200000; ordered Before=amr.service; ExecStop sets no_turbo = 1; Conflicts=cpu-no-turbo.service
services.cpu-no-turbo.service: older unit-1-only service, disabled and superseded

cpu.status: as_built (model, stock values, throttling record); deploy_intent (caps: installed by install.sh, enabled by hand per unit)
cpu.source: alpha-setup.md sections 0 and 6 step 4; amr_ws/deploy/cpu-freq-cap.service; amr_ws/deploy/cpu-power-limit.service

gpu.xorg_driver: modesetting (generic KMS), AccelMethod glamor, TearFree true
gpu.forbidden_package: xserver-xorg-video-intel (legacy DDX, unreliable on Alder Lake-N)
gpu.note: The GA 5.15 kernel predates the N97 iGPU support, which is one reason for the HWE kernel.

memory.swap: removed by design: vm.swappiness = 0, swap file deleted (swapoff -a, swap.img removed from fstab)
memory.status: as_built (size); deploy_intent (swap removal is a manual step after install.sh)

total_disk_gb.status: inferred from root + free space in the VG

data_volume.label: amr-data
data_volume.purpose: vehicle state and maps on a fully journalled filesystem, so a power cut cannot cost the root filesystem
data_volume.precondition: VFree at least 40G; never shrink ubuntu-lv

storage.source: alpha-setup.md sections 0 and 6.2; amr_ws/RUNBOOK.md 'Data on its own volume'; amr_ws/deploy/amr-data-volume.conf

network_interfaces.name: enp3s0
network_interfaces.label: LAN2
peers: 192.168.3.10 SICK nanoScan3 (CoLa2 TCP 2122; UDP scan data to host :6060)

network_interfaces.name: can0
network_interfaces.device_node: /dev/canable0 (udev symlink to ttyACMn, matched by USB serial)

network_interfaces.name: lo
network_interfaces.role: all ROS 2 DDS traffic (CycloneDDS bound to loopback only, no multicast)

networking_policy.split: NetworkManager owns Wi-Fi only; netplan/systemd-networkd owns every wired port (nmcli does nothing on the ethernet ports)
networking_policy.default_routes: exactly two by design: usb0 (metric 100) then wlp1s0 (metric 700); the wired LANs never carry one
networking_policy.renderer: renderer: networkd scoped inside the ethernets block, so a regenerated cloud-init file cannot take Wi-Fi down
networking_policy.wifi_rejoin: agv-wifi-reconnect.service: scans every 3 s while unassociated, brings agv-net up at >= 25 % signal

canable.udev_rule: /etc/udev/rules.d/70-canable.rules, rendered from amr_ws/deploy/70-canable.rules.in with the profile's can.adapter_serial
canable.rule_details: ACTION!="remove" (survives change events), MODE 0660 GROUP dialout, ID_MM_DEVICE_IGNORE=1 (no ModemManager probing), SYSTEMD_WANTS=canable@can0.service
canable.service: canable@.service: BindsTo=dev-canable0.device, Restart=on-failure, RestartSec=2, StartLimitBurst 10 per 60 s; never enabled, started by udev

display.panel: 6-7 inch touch display, about 1280x720 CSS px
display.display_manager: LightDM, autologin of amrkiosk into the amr-kiosk session; session cleanup restarts lightdm
display.kiosk_session: matchbox-window-manager + unclutter + display hot-plug watcher + Chromium (snap) in --kiosk mode on http://127.0.0.1/
display.front_door: nginx-light on :80 proxying to 127.0.0.1:5001, with a holding page when the service is down

firmware_boot.bootloader: GRUB, stock: GRUB_TIMEOUT=0, hidden menu, no extra kernel parameters
firmware_boot.fallback_kernel: the GA 5.15 kernel is kept as the GRUB fallback by freeze.sh (unit 2: 5.15.0-185-generic)

operating_system.install_type: Ubuntu Server (cloud-init netplan, LVM, OpenSSH server) with xfce4 added

kernel.why_hwe: the GA 5.15 kernel predates the N97 iGPU and the i226 NIC quirks
kernel.purged: the GA kernel metapackages (linux-generic, linux-image-generic, linux-headers-generic); the GA image stays as fallback
kernel.watchdog_module_note: the HWE kernel package blacklists watchdog modules by alias in /lib/modprobe.d/; loading by name via modules-load.d still works

operating_system.hostname_rule: gvipc-evo-NN must run profile agv-NN (checked at every service start)
operating_system.time_sync: chrony (systemd-timesyncd masked); makestep 1 3: step only in the first three updates after start, slew afterwards
operating_system.ros: ROS 2 Humble (ros-base, no desktop), from snapshots.ros.org/humble/2026-09-14; about 265 ros-humble-* packages
operating_system.status: as_built (distribution, kernel, timezone, packages); deploy_intent (snapshot pin, chrony drop-in)

package_management.ros_source: /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros2-snapshot.sources -> http://snapshots.ros.org/humble/2026-09-14/ubuntu jammy main, amd64, signed by the snapshot keyring (fingerprint checked, fails closed)
package_management.live_ros_repo: packages.ros.org pinned to priority -1 (/etc/apt/preferences.d/60-amr); ros2-apt-source purged
package_management.unattended_upgrades: off (APT::Periodic::* 0); even by hand never linux-*, ros-humble-* or nodejs; no automatic reboot
package_management.apt_timers: apt-daily.timer, apt-daily-upgrade.timer, update-notifier-download.timer disabled and masked by freeze.sh
package_management.snaps: every snap held for ever (snap refresh --hold), the kiosk Chromium included
package_management.needrestart: never preselects amr, amr-failed, canable@, systemd-networkd, chrony, nginx, lightdm, agv-wifi-reconnect; no kernel hints
package_management.update_policy: monthly maintenance window, run by hand
package_management.status: deploy_intent (freeze.sh --go; not yet run on unit 2 as of 2026-11-18)

reasons.dirty_*: shorter window where written data exists only in RAM before a power cut
reasons.rmem_max: CycloneDDS asks for 1 MiB socket buffers; the old 212992 cap overflowed on lo (265 RcvbufErrors, 2026-10-24)
reasons.kernel.panic: reboot 10 s after a panic instead of hanging

kernel_tuning.known_harmless_warnings: sysctl --system prints 'Invalid argument' for net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route and promote_secondaries from Ubuntu's own 50-default.conf

power_management.sleep: sleep, suspend, hibernate and hybrid-sleep targets masked

watchdogs.hardware: Intel chipset TCO watchdog, module iTCO_wdt (/etc/modules-load.d/iTCO_wdt.conf)
watchdogs.precondition: check wdctl and lsmod | grep -i iTCO first; harmless where /dev/watchdog is missing

logging.tmpfiles_ageing: ~/.amr/ros_log and ~/.ros/log 7 days, ~/.amr/runs 30 days (/etc/tmpfiles.d/amr.conf); existing directories only

trimmed_os_services.reversible: trim-services.sh --revert restores the state saved by the first --go

operator.sudo: password required; only two NOPASSWD lines in /etc/sudoers.d/amr-web
operator.note: the same user name on every unit: deploy files hard-code /home/gvipc-evo-01

python_runtime_libraries.known_conflict: user-site numpy 2.x breaks the system cv_bridge (built on numpy 1.21); nothing imports cv_bridge

not_in_repo: SSD or eMMC model, interface and exact capacity
RAM type, speed and slot layout
Chassis serial numbers and NEXCOM part revision
Supply input range of the PC and how it is fed from the 48 V pack
Operating temperature range from the vendor datasheet
Display panel model (only the Goodix touch controller is recorded)
